UCLA C-I-CARE/Patient Experience Practices: MY COMMITMENT TO CARE
Observe departmental Patient Experience plan, competencies and practices.
Provide age appropriate assessment and interventions in order to meet the needs of patients and families served.
Interviews patients and measure vital signs and other pertinent information as required by the department. Records information in patients' medical records.
Prepares treatment rooms and patients for examination.
Assists clinician with care of the patient. Inventories, orders and replenishes medical supplies and materials.
Performs treatments and performs routine laboratory tests as required by the department.

Anticipates the customers' needs, takes proactive steps to meet those needs, by listening and taking responsibility within scope to ensure issues are resolved. Promptly responds to alarms and patient requests.
Facilitates the customers' ability to utilize resources.
Assures a clean, orderly, and functional work environment
. Team Commitment: Is an effective team member who is flexible, cooperative, and willing to assist others.
A. Assist physician/patients for office visits.
1.                   Rooming patients accurately take and record vital signs in patient’s medical record utilizing EPIC/Care Connect system.
2.                   Verify and/or administer medications (as directed) and record medications in patient medical record.
3.                   Recognize symptomatology of common medical illnesses.
4.                   Participate in patient care in the community office setting.
5.                   Documents all patient care activities in the Electronic Medical Record - EPIC/Care Connect system
6.                   Respond to physical and emotional needs of patients.
7.                   Provide support and act as a liaison between patient, family, and health care providers.
8.                   Maintain, promote and model a team approach to patient care
9.                   Prepare and assist physicians in special procedures for patients.
10.               Perform basic tasks including EKG’s routinely and in emergencies.
11.               Perform venipuncture and perform waived tests dependent on laboratory equipment at facility as well as prepare specimens and requisitions for transport to the main laboratory.
12.               Recognize abnormal laboratory values and report to physician.
13.               Assist in the refills of patient prescriptions by obtaining medical record, notifying physician, and returning call to pharmacy after approval received from physician.
14.               Perform BLS and assist patients in an emergency situation.
15.               Maintain accurate records of Quality Control values as required for waived tests performed.
16.               Recognize and report all equipment malfunctions to manager.
17.               Accurately record temperatures on all refrigerators and freezers and keep any logs as required per policy.
18.               Perform vision and hearing tests as requested.
19.               Assist in educating patients in preparation for special examinations, such as flexible sigmoidoscopy.
20.               Assist with follow up for referrals to specialists.
21.               Review chart prior to visit to determine if reports are pending, obtain.
22.               Prepare information for physician for specialized visits such as Well Child Visits, Well-male   information sheet for PSA, VIS for immunizations.
23.               Follow up and respond to Care Connect in basket messages and messages coming in from patients through MYUCLAHEALTH in a timely manner.  Including messages coming from physicians
24.               Assist with organizing sample medications and notify drug company representatives of needed supplies.
25.               Prepare reports for physician review by presenting them to the physician with the patient chart.
26.               Schedules appointments, performs clinical tasks and completes appropriate forms as required by department.
27.               May be responsible for administering medications, including injections.
28.               May be responsible for cleaning, processing, sterilizing and checking instruments.
29.               Performs computer data entry functions.
30.               Performs clinical/technical skills specific to the department. Performs other related duties as necessary.
1.                   Stock exam rooms as needed.
2.                   Set up exam rooms for procedures including, but not limited to, sigmoidoscopies, pelvic examinations, thoracentesis, and lumbar punctures, colposcopies.
3.                   Adhere to all policies and standards set by UCLA Health.
1.                   Participates in orientation of new staff and medical externs.
2.                   Participate in unit staff meetings and in-service sessions to contribute to process improvements.
3.                   Participate in the creating and update of all clinical schedules & assigned duties list.
4.                   Maintain par levels for clinical and medication supplies and order weekly or as needed if sooner.
5.                   Assist in the orientation new health care personnel to the physical set up, equipment and general policies and procedures within the clinic.
6.                   Assist with front office functions to include: telephone communication, scheduling appointments, chart preparation, filing, faxing, photocopying, prescription refills.
7.                   Interact in a cooperative manner with physicians, patients, other staff members and other departments under pressure situations.
8.                   Organize tasks to facilitate smooth patient flow.
9.                   Respond to patient requests for educational information and provide.
10.               Follow proper channels of communications.
11.               Follow proper chain of command.
12.               Adhere to all University Policies.
13.               Understand and adhere to all specific safety regulations regarding Bloodborne Pathogens and other hazardous material.
14.               Assist with maintaining medical records as per department policy as needed.
15.               Other duties as assigned.
UCLA C-I-CARE/Patient Experience Practices: MY COMMITMENT TO CARE
Observe and practice all the Service Standards listed in the “World Class Practices” (which I have read and signed).
o   Practice C-I-CARE when interacting with patients, their families, visitors, or internal customers.
o   Connect with the patient and family members by addressing them as Mr./Ms., or by the name that they prefer.
o   Introduce yourself and your role.
o   Communicate what you are going to do, how long it is going to take, and how it will impact the patient.
o   Ask and anticipate patient and/or family needs, questions or concerns.
o   Respond to patient and/or family questions and requests with immediacy.
o   Exit courteously and/or with an explanation of what will come next (or when you will be back to check on them).
o   Practice C-I-CARE phone etiquette during all phone interactions
Always exercise courtesy whenever patients, family members, visitors and co-workers are present.
Respect privacy and dignity of our patients, family members, visitors and co-workers.
Maintain professionalism in the presence of patients, their families, visitors and co-workers
Observe departmental Patient Experience plan, competencies and practices.
Act as a role model, verbally and behaviorally demonstrating skill, enthusiasm, positive problem solving, commitment and loyalty to the profession and the organization.
Participate in positive problem solving by providing suggestions and possible solutions to identified concerns/problems in the work place.
Comply with Health System Workplace Conduct Policy

Engaging in disruptive behaviors that interfere with or prevent normal work functions or compromise patient safety, including passive or active behaviors will not be tolerated as stated in the HS Workplace Conduct Policy.
Comply with Health System Dress Code Policy and practices
